query: SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = $1 OR (previous_token_hash = $1 AND previous_valid_until > NOW()) FOR UPDATE

method.measuredBoundary: Complete round-trip of synthetic session SELECT FOR UPDATE; no auth route, HTTP, user lookup or request-hook work.
method.order: Before-index warm samples then after-index warm samples on the exact same generated sessions; cache state is warm, not randomized.

postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

baselineIndexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX sessions_expiry_idx ON public.sessions USING btree (expires_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_pkey ON public.sessions USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_token_hash_unique ON public.sessions USING btree (token_hash)
CREATE INDEX sessions_user_idx ON public.sessions USING btree (user_id)

scope: Synthetic generated database only; no real credentials, usernames, URLs or session secrets. UUIDs and hashes are generated fixture identity.
